digest.component_or_area: ticket planning and lifecycle intent modeling
propositions: Binding changes must be represented as versioned lifecycle intents where intent.version equals the enclosing Observation.version exactly.

Create-before-link and parent-before-child prerequisites must be modeled as explicit inter-ticket dependencies in plan formation, with blocked prerequisites deferring and never emitting out-of-order mutations.

Selection, filter, mode cap, and global safety limit exclusions must be applied before any lifecycle intent eligibility or remote effect, each tagged with a deterministic defer_reason (scope_deferred, safety_aborted, or dependency_deferred).
Ticket-sourced conditions including tombstones, index lag, moved keys, impossible links, and partial snapshots must map to deterministic skipped dispositions during pure planning.
The plan_pass function must perform no repository or provider writes and must incorporate pre-effect exclusion logic with reason tagging while remaining a pure transformation.
Lifecycle intents carry no independent version counter; all intent versioning is derived from the frozen Observation.version fingerprint and pass_id.
